name: schema-narrow-field-attribute-not-cleared
description: The fold-level mechanic behind the WRIT-200 decision (spec/schema-ops.md §Clearing a field attribute, ARCHITECTURE.md §Schema layer): each define-field body key is its own independent keyed-lww register (field_value_type, field_enum, ...), overwritten only when a later op's body actually carries that key. op-narrow redeclares standup/create/1's 'state' field as a bare string, so it overwrites field_value_type, but its body carries no 'enum' key at all — field_enum is never touched and keeps op-root's value forever. Nothing here is a bug: this is exactly why narrowing an attribute is unrepresentable without a new op_version (spec/schema-ops.md §Clearing a field attribute), while widening (a later op whose body does carry the key) already applies cleanly.
